ambiguities_resolved_fail_closed: the closed error set (ADD v1.3 :2329-2352) has no Decision-specific code: a missing, unsigned, non-C6, non-ACCEPT, non-CANONICAL_COMMIT or expired Decision is POLICY_DENIED; a missing, unsigned, out-of-window or revoked Authority is AUTHORITY_MISSING; incoherence with the GatePackage is GATE_PACKAGE_MISMATCH
admission runs before the idempotent replay: a retry after Decision expiry is denied, never committed twice
unregistered Evidence is CONTRACT_REJECTED; an active stop or a changed stop epoch is EMERGENCY_STOP_ACTIVE; a release other than the active one is RELEASE_MISMATCH
an unknown or false precondition is PRECONDITION_FAILED and an unknown or false invariant is INVARIANT_VIOLATION, both evaluated inside the transaction on the locked state (ADD v1.3 :2569)
a pre-existing PostgreSQL C3 table of another shape is SCHEMA_MISMATCH, never altered
a relay claim lasts at most claim_ttl (server idle-in-transaction timeout, minimum 1 s) and a new claim ends the previous one
a TerminusDB protocol or shape error is BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE and its message carries only the status and the api:error type, never the body

a PostgreSQL driver failure is BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE when the server is unreachable (OperationalError, InterfaceError) and BACKEND_ERROR otherwise, in C3 (PostgresAdapterError, C3Error through the service) and in the C8 Run Ledger (RunLedgerError); the server text is never in the message

a stored row of another shape (missing column, bool or text for an integer, naive instant, unknown kind or outcome, non-object JSONB) is BACKEND_ERROR, never converted; replayed commit revisions that are not consecutive are COMMIT_RECEIPT_MISMATCH

a C3 event without from_revision, with from_revision not a non-bool integer >= 0 or with to_revision != from_revision + 1 is SCHEMA_VIOLATION for the projector; an outbox entry without its event context is COMMIT_RECEIPT_MISMATCH for the relay
in the memory promotion consumer an issued command that differs from the gate command in any field but gate_package_digest is refused C6_COMMAND_BINDING_MISMATCH before dispatch
